name: 3D Video Editing Part 1
description: Autonomous 3D Video Director & Production Engine (Part 1 - Faceless Shorts): Make narrated faceless YouTube Shorts / TikToks / Reels fully in code: free local AI voice (Kokoro), Whisper word-synced captions, animated 3D & 2D shots, sound and music, rendered to MP4. Six styles: Deep Dive 3D, Night File 3D, Inside Out, Stick Story, Paper Atlas, Tall Tale 3D. Anti-LMK Shield, High-Speed Render Presets (--fast, --turbo, --1080p). No API keys, no credits.
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: studio_3d_status
mcp_tools.description: Check 3D Video Editing Part 1 status, 6 flagship visual styles (Deep Dive 3D, Night File 3D, Tall Tale 3D, Inside Out, Stick Story, Paper Atlas), audio engine, and render presets.

mcp_tools.name: studio_3d_list_styles
mcp_tools.description: List all 6 code-driven 3D & 2D styles, aesthetic descriptions, camera recipes, and sample running times.

style.description: Optional specific style name to inspect (deep-dive, night-file, tall-tale, inside-out, stick-story, paper-atlas).

mcp_tools.name: studio_3d_plan_short
mcp_tools.description: Generate a shot plan and directorial breakdown for a 3D Faceless Short based on chosen style and script.

topic.description: Topic or title of the 3D short.

style.description: Visual style: deep-dive (Zack D. Films 3D), night-file (noir mystery), tall-tale (3D cartoon), inside-out (2D x-ray), stick-story (survival steps), or paper-atlas (cut paper map).

mcp_tools.name: studio_3d_render_command
mcp_tools.description: Get the precise CLI render commands for mobile or desktop (fast 720p HD mobile default, turbo 540p draft 45-55 fps, or full 1080p master).

project_dir.description: Path to the faceless short project directory.

preset.description: Rendering preset: fast (720p HD mobile default, < 140MB RAM), turbo (540p draft, 45-55 fps), or 1080p (broadcast master).
